Good morning, Clara. It's Daniel Reed. Thank you for making time for our arranged call. Is this still a convenient moment to speak?

Yes, thank you, Daniel. I've just come in from the garden, so the timing is good. I'd appreciate keeping the discussion focused, though. I have some planting to finish before the weather changes.

Certainly. Before we begin, would you prefer routine relationship calls in the morning, or does later in the day generally work better?

Later in the morning is usually best. I like getting outside early, and I don't always hear the telephone from the garden. An arranged call is much easier than an unexpected one.

I'll note that scheduling preference. We can arrange routine conversations in advance rather than interrupting your day. Let's cover the administrative details and then move directly to the investment discussion.

My identification number is G seven nine seven four nine four six U. My date of birth is the twentieth of November nineteen sixty-four. The fund I want to invest in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund.

Clara, your objective is to seek income and diversify your sources of bond exposure, while being prepared to hold through market volatility. That is the objective I am using for our discussion. With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, emerging-market issuers may default or suffer credit downgrades, reducing the value of the bonds the fund holds. Rising interest rates can also lower the value of its bond holdings. Do you understand how issuer defaults, credit downgrades and rising interest rates could reduce the fund's value?

Yes, I understand those risks. Defaults or downgrades can reduce the value of the underlying bonds, and rising interest rates can push their market prices down.

The transaction charge is 0.5% of the amount invested. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this holding, including losses arising from emerging-market credit risk?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses on this holding. I am comfortable taking emerging-market credit risk as part of my diversified portfolio.

I recommend Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because its emerging-market debt holdings add a different source of bond income and credit exposure to your portfolio. That supports your income and diversification objectives, given your willingness to hold through volatility.

I want to buy, please. Please place the transaction in euros. The amount I want to invest is 75,000. The quantity I am instructing is 500 units. Please use a market order for this transaction.

Please explicitly confirm your final instruction: buy 500 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, for an investment amount of 75,000 euros, using a market order. Shall I proceed on that basis?

Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please proceed exactly as you have just stated.

Thank you, Clara. That concludes the discussion for today. If you have any administrative questions afterward, please contact me through the usual bank channels.

Thank you, Daniel. That was focused, which I appreciate. I'll leave you to your day and get back to the garden. Goodbye.

Enjoy the rest of your morning, Clara. Goodbye.
